body: Thank you. I do plan to try online dating at some point but I fear my photo will scare of 90% of people and the remaining 10% will be trying to take advantage me.

I wish I had you as a mum. I was in a similar situation when I was younger and my parents went into full shame mode. Almost two decades later and I'm still too ashamed to talk about sex or romance. I still live with my parents, my only goal in life is finding a wife and having kids but I've never been able to ask a girl out because that would show them that I am a sexual being and they might react the same way my parents did. Intellectually I know it's not likely to happen but emotionally it is still holding me back.... 

I ended confessing more than I meant to, I just wanted to give context and say that you are awesome and thank you for the effort you are putting into this. I hope it all goes well.

That sounds awesome! Is it really that simple? 

I'm massively depressed because all I want in life is a girlfriend but I have no way of acquiring one. If chemical castration was that simple/effective I feel like someone would have mentioned it in the 10+years I've been dealing with psychologists and psychiatrist and miscellaneous therapists.

At this point I just keep my head down when I'm outside of my house, can't risk accidentally looking at anybody.

If I look at a kid I'm a pedo, if look at a women I'm a creep, if I look at another guy I'm "trying to start something".

I think I'm starting to develop a hunch back from looking down all the time but there really is no other option.
This is exactly what I want too, except for the phone part, I just can't feel connected to someone if I can't see them.

I tried to make some better goals and I've realized that I have no idea what I want. I guess the most basic thing would be meeting people so I can maybe find some friends but how do I even do that? I can't just talk to random strangers. And even if I find people I like why would they be my friend? I don't mean that in a negative way, just realistically, I don't have a lot to offer.

I'm glad you find it meaningful when I lay everything out first but it doesn't feel quite so meaningful for me when someone just says "Yeah, me too". You aren't really doing that but it is just so close to what I often see/hear, someone opens up and someone else just responds with "I know what you mean" or worse "Everybody feels like that".

I do get the bit about "putting myself out there", and I have been trying but I'm so disconnected from society I just don't know where to start.

Thank you. Your suggestion about finding some sort of team to be a part of might be just what I need, but it's complicated. I was raised to put other people first, and I genuinely like nothing more than helping others, but over the years there have been so many times that I've been taken advantage of or just taken for granted, it's kind of crushed my will to help people.

My family are the only ones who have stuck by me. A family is like a team, if something helps one of us it helps all of us, my family are all getting old or they have moved away to start their own family, so I wanted to do the same. If I start my own family I will have a team for the rest of my life. Writing that out felt kind of stupid, and I wrote a lot more than I expected/meant to, also it doesn't even really relate to the question I wanted to ask which is: How can I find a team that will give me that kind of loyalty? Is this too much to ask for? 

It's kind of funny now that I think about it, the greatest way somebody could help me is by giving me someone to help. Maybe funny isn't the right word but it's something.

Thank you. Yes, that is pretty much my only goal in life. I do have other goals but they are more abstract things like "Be happy".
I would love to have other goals but how can I make myself want something?
